info.title: SkyGuard AI — Meteorological Data Quality & Anomaly Detection API
info.description: REST API for Automatic Weather Station telemetry, quality control, and sensor health.

get.description: Process liveness probe indicating whether the server process is alive and responsive.

schema.title: Response Health Live Health Live Get

get.description:
Readiness probe evaluating the operational state of core subsystems and dependencies.

Returns HTTP 200 when ready to accept traffic.
Returns HTTP 503 only when core internal state is uninitialized or critically blocked.

schema.title: Response Health Ready Health Ready Get

get.description: List all configured Automatic Weather Stations with coordinates and status.

schema.title: Response List Stations Api V1 Stations Get

get.description: Get metadata for a specific station.

schema.title: Response Get Station Api V1 Stations  Station Id  Get

get.description: Get real-time operational status snapshot for a station.
Get chronological observation telemetry for a station with filters and pagination.
Get latest continuous 0-100 Sensor Health evaluation for a station.

schema.title: Response Get Station Health Api V1 Stations  Station Id  Health Get

get.description: List detected anomalies with multi-criteria filtering and pagination.
Get single anomaly event record by its unique event ID.
Get complete Explainability package (SHAP attributions, neighbor comparison, SOP steps).
List advisory correction recommendations with multi-field filtering and pagination.
Get single advisory correction recommendation record by its observation ID.

post.description: Ingest and process a single WeatherObservation through the full analytical intelligence pipeline.
Process a sequential batch of WeatherObservations.

schema.title: Response Process Observation Batch Api V1 Observations Batch Post

get.description: Get end-to-end service status of all core subsystems (database, model, pipeline, replay).
Get current status of the stream replay simulator.

schema.title: Response Get Replay Status Api V1 Replay Status Get

get.description: List all available frozen demonstration scenarios.

schema.title: Response List Replay Scenarios Api V1 Replay Scenarios Get

post.description: Load a specific demonstration scenario from the registry.

schema.title: Response Load Replay Scenario Api V1 Replay Load Scenario Post

post.description: Step the replay simulation forward by N observations.

schema.title: Response Step Replay Simulation Api V1 Replay Step Post

post.description: Reset transient demo simulation state without destructive database operations.

schema.title: Response Reset Replay Simulation Api V1 Replay Reset Post

get.description: Get comprehensive operational health, request metrics, outage episodes, and station freshness matrix.

schema.title: Response Get Live Source Health Api V1 Live Source Health Get

get.description: Get high-level status indicator for navigation badges and operational overview.

schema.title: Response Get Live Status Api V1 Live Status Get

post.description: Trigger an immediate synchronous poll cycle across all configured stations.

schema.title: Response Trigger Immediate Poll Api V1 Live Poll Now Post

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Alert severity level (INFO, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

AnomalyEventRecord.title: AnomalyEventRecord
AnomalyEventRecord.description: Traceable anomaly event record persisted upon detection.

explanation_method.title: Explanation Method
explanation_method.description: Method used to compute feature contributions.

generated_at.title: Generated At
generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when explanation was produced.

AuditMetadata.title: AuditMetadata
AuditMetadata.description: Traceable provenance metadata for reproducible auditability.

anomaly_health.title: Anomaly Health
anomaly_health.description: Health deduced from anomalous event frequency.

data_quality_health.title: Data Quality Health
data_quality_health.description: Health deduced from missingness and schema validity.

communication_health.title: Communication Health
communication_health.description: Health deduced from packet gaps and telemetry latency.

temporal_stability_health.title: Temporal Stability Health
temporal_stability_health.description: Health deduced from flatlines and variance behavior.

spatial_consistency_health.title: Spatial Consistency Health
spatial_consistency_health.description: Health deduced from isolated spatial disagreements.

ComponentHealthScores.title: ComponentHealthScores
ComponentHealthScores.description: Component reliability indicators across 5 distinct sub-domains (0-100 scale).

ContributionDirection.title: ContributionDirection
ContributionDirection.description: Direction of a feature's contribution towards anomaly classification.

CorrectionAuditMetadata.title: CorrectionAuditMetadata
CorrectionAuditMetadata.description: Complete provenance and model tracking for correction recommendations.

observed_value.title: Observed Value
observed_value.description: Raw observed value from sensor (remains immutable).

method.description: Algorithm used to derive the recommended estimate.

reason_codes.title: Reason Codes
reason_codes.description: Reason codes from upstream decision engine.

multivariate_consistent.title: Multivariate Consistent
multivariate_consistent.description: True if recommended value satisfies joint physical laws.

CorrectionRecommendation.title: CorrectionRecommendation
CorrectionRecommendation.description: Strictly separated non-destructive correction recommendation for a suspicious observation.

quality_status.title: Quality Status
quality_status.description: High-level ingestion status (VALID, REJECTED, GAP, DUPLICATE).

missing_fields.title: Missing Fields
missing_fields.description: List of missing required meteorological fields.

is_out_of_order.title: Is Out Of Order
is_out_of_order.description: True if packet arrived out of chronological sequence.

is_physical_out_of_bounds.title: Is Physical Out Of Bounds
is_physical_out_of_bounds.description: True if raw value exceeds planetary limits.

DataQualityEvidence.title: DataQualityEvidence
DataQualityEvidence.description: Evidence derived from telemetry integrity, schemas, and communication checks.

contradicting_evidence.title: Contradicting Evidence
contradicting_evidence.description: Subsystems contradicting or ruling out alternatives.

unavailable_evidence.title: Unavailable Evidence
unavailable_evidence.description: Subsystems with missing or insufficient telemetry.

DecisionExplanation.title: DecisionExplanation
DecisionExplanation.description: Structured, human-readable and machine-traceable explanation of decision rationale.

DecisionReasonCode.title: DecisionReasonCode
DecisionReasonCode.description: Stable, machine-readable reason codes explaining decision triggers.

EstimationMethod.title: EstimationMethod
EstimationMethod.description: Mathematical and algorithmic methods used for estimation.

direct_evidence.title: Direct Evidence
direct_evidence.description: Direct physical sensor readings, timestamps, and raw neighbor values.

model_evidence.title: Model Evidence
model_evidence.description: ML anomaly score, decision score, calibrated threshold, and top feature attributions.

contextual_evidence.title: Contextual Evidence
contextual_evidence.description: Spatial network consensus, temporal dynamics (rate, flatline), and multivariate physics.

operational_interpretation.title: Operational Interpretation
operational_interpretation.description: High-level operational interpretation (e.g., 'probable sensor anomaly', 'possible regional event').

EvidenceHierarchy.title: EvidenceHierarchy
EvidenceHierarchy.description: Structured taxonomy separating direct, model, contextual, and operational evidence.

EvidenceState.title: EvidenceState
EvidenceState.description: Standardized alignment of a specific subsystem evidence source relative to a hypothesis.

feature_contributions.title: Feature Contributions
feature_contributions.description: Ranked ML feature attributions from actual model.
